provenance.note: MRSAC's named drainage segments for the Nag, Pili, Pora, Kanhan, Kolar and Wainganga, clipped to the frame 20.9-21.75 N, 78.75-79.65 E, one MultiLineString per river; the Nag is first because the rivers page opens the first river, and is its main connected course only (a separate 10.9 km channel MRSAC also names Nag Nadi drains south toward Hingna and is left out). length_km is the mapped length inside that frame, not the river's full course.
